evidence: AWS Open Data Sentinel-2 chips (s2aws.py) obtained this run at the verified site coordinate, 2022-06 through 2026-07: all four show unbroken ranchland/pasture with natural terrain terracing, farm roads, and no solar array, staging, or grading -- no construction activity through the most recent (2026-07-02) scene

Prior run's CDSE-only imagery attempt returned HTTP 402 (account-level openEO credit exhaustion) and gmaps.py hit rate limits / inactive API -- both superseded this run by s2aws.py (AWS Open Data, no quota)
Consistent with no construction-start milestone in the ERCOT queue and GIA NTP not yet observed

reasoning_evidence: Signed GIA Exhibit B (PUCT 35077-2140, filed 2025-05-19, executed March 2025) states Scheduled Commercial Operation Date = 08/08/2027, EXACTLY matching the queue's reported COD -- contractually grounded, not a stale/self-reported queue artifact

Queue history (timeline.md): reported COD has been stable at 2027-08-08 for 17 consecutive monthly snapshots since 2025-02-01, i.e. unchanged since the IA was signed -- no drift since contract execution

In-Service Date per Exhibit B: later of 1100 days from Generator's notice-to-proceed-with-construction-with-security, or 03/31/2027 -- floor date is fixed but the 1100-day clause means an actual NTP date could push this later; NTP date itself not observed
Scheduled Trial Operation Date: 'To be determined' -- schedule not fully fixed even in the signed agreement

No construction-start milestone reported in the queue as of the 2026-06-01 snapshot (13 months before reported COD) and NOT in EIA-860M yet -- both consistent with pre-construction/pre-NTP stage, not necessarily a red flag for a ~13-18mo solar build, but leaves no observed schedule cushion
Imagery ground-truth unobtainable this run (CDSE/Google Maps blocked) -- cannot independently verify whether construction has actually begun despite the queue showing no milestone
